items.title: 63519_Wild Bill Davison oral history interview
items.q: you had Joe Barufaldi - called himself Joe Barry-- [INTERVIEWEE] Yeah well I told him I'd like to be off maybe about three or four weeks and it turned into eight, or nine or ten---

ctx.x: No, I'd usually take some of the guys out of the band if they wanted to go. I'd take Gene if he wanted to go and Cutty gladly and any of the clarinet players that wanted to go, I'd take.

Now, the main break you made at permanent; Condon's and you almost made it it came in about what - 1951 - when you formed that band that was such an outstanding band; you had Joe Barufaldi - called himself Joe Barry--
Yeah well I told him I'd like to be off maybe about three or four weeks and it turned into eight, or nine or ten---
